fullDescription: Premium minimalist dark mode portfolio and studio style guide. Features a sophisticated editorial aesthetic using a taupe (#b7ab98) and coral (#eb5939) palette on a deep charcoal (#0d0d0d) background. Suitable for high-end digital agencies, art directors, product designers, and luxury brand showcases. Employs brutalist typography with 'Clash Grotesk' and 'Satoshi', combined with sophisticated micro-interactions like magnetic buttons, custom cursor rings, and scroll-triggered revealing animations. Layout focuses on a bento-style grid, large-scale headings, and high-quality whitespace balance.

structured.summary: A refined, dark-themed design system for high-end professional portfolios or creative agencies. It combines editorial layouts with modern reactivity, featuring a distinct grain/noise texture, spinning badges, and fluid transitions between sections. The color system uses low-contrast borders and elevated surfaces to create depth without relying on heavy shadows.

style.description: The style is defined by its 'Brutalist-Light' approach: clean, high-contrast typography paired with a muted, earthy color palette and vibrant accent colors. Typography pairs 'Clash Grotesk' for high-impact headings and 'Satoshi' for legible body text. Visual depth is achieved through subtle noise overlays (opacity 0.03) and large, soft radial glows. Animation uses a signature 'cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)' curve for all reveals and transitions to ensure a snappy yet smooth feel.
style.prompt: Create a premium dark mode UI with a background of #0d0d0d and a subtle grain noise texture overlay. Use 'Clash Grotesk' for bold, impactful headings and 'Satoshi' for body text. Primary accent color is Taupe (#b7ab98), used for highlights and secondary buttons. Secondary accent is Coral (#eb5939), used for critical highlights and interactive symbols. Implement thin, low-opacity borders (rgba(118, 118, 118, 0.12)). Animation: All elements should reveal with a 1-second transition using cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), with staggered delays of 0.08s for list items. Include a custom cursor consisting of a small 8px dot and a trailing 40px ring that expands on hover. Links should have a 'magnetic' hover effect and a 1px solid underline that expands from left-to-right on hover.

layout_and_structure.description: A vertical-scrolling landing page structure using a 1400px max-width container. Employs section-based partitioning with thin horizontal rules, utilizing a mix of 12-column grids and flex-based rows.

prompts.prompt: Sticky top bar with a transition from transparent to #0d0d0d on scroll. Left-aligned logo in Clash Grotesk. Right-aligned navigation links in 11px uppercase Satoshi with 0.14em letter-spacing. Include a pill-shaped 'Let's Talk' button with 1px border. On mobile, use a full-screen slide-in menu (transform: translateX) with staggered links.

Split layout. Left side features a 'Multidisciplinary' eyebrow with a horizontal line, followed by massive headings (font-size: 130px) using line-mask reveals. Right side features a spinning SVG circular badge ('OPEN TO WORK' text path) with a central magnetic arrow button. Include soft radial glows (opacity 0.04) in the background.
Infinite scrolling text track with large uppercase outlined or low-opacity text. Separate keywords with a Coral (#eb5939) star symbol (✦). Animation speed: 30s linear loop. Pause on hover.

2-column grid. Each card is a 4:3 aspect ratio container with an image that scales (scale(1.06)) and loses grayscale on hover. Overlay a button that appears on hover. Include large background numerals (e.g., '01', '02') in high-weight Clash Grotesk at 72px with 0.1 opacity in the top-right corner of the image container.

Full-width rows with top/bottom 1px borders. Each row features a number (e.g., 01), a large heading, and a hidden description that reveals on hover. On hover, the row should shift right by 16px and show a Coral arrow icon sliding in from the left.
4-column grid. Each step includes a circular icon with a 1px border. Connecting lines between steps are 1px thick with linear-gradient fading. Use uppercase 'Phase 01' labels in Coral font.

4-column grid layout. Includes brand summary, 'Navigate' links, 'Connect' social links, and contact info. Bottom bar features copyright, social icons with magnetic effects, and a 'Back to Top' button with an arrow-up icon.

special_ui_components.description: A rotating circular badge with a text-on-path SVG.
special_ui_components.prompt: Create an SVG with a circular path. Use a textPath element with font-size 12.5px and letter-spacing 4. Set the text to 'OPEN TO WORK • FREELANCE AVAILABLE •'. Apply a CSS animation: 'spin 22s linear infinite'. Center a 64px magnetic circle inside the badge with a hover transition from Taupe (#b7ab98) to Coral (#eb5939).

special_ui_components.description: A button that subtly follows the mouse cursor when nearby.
special_ui_components.prompt: Apply a CSS transition: 'transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)'. On hover, translate the element -3px vertically. For advanced implementation, use JavaScript to calculate mouse distance and translate the button up to 15px toward the cursor position.

special_ui_components.description: Headings that appear to slide up from behind an invisible floor.
special_ui_components.prompt: Wrap each line of text in a container with 'overflow: hidden'. The inner span should start with 'transform: translateY(115%)' and animate to 'translateY(0)' with a 1.15s cubic-bezier curve. Stagger the lines by 0.15s each.

structured.special_notes: Maintain a strict 0.03 opacity on the noise filter to avoid making the UI look 'dirty'. Ensure all interactive elements (links, cards, buttons) trigger the 'hov' class on the custom cursor ring. Spacing must be consistent: use 24px-36px for section padding and 1400px as the maximum container width. Avoid drop shadows; use #1a1a1a background for elevated surfaces instead.
